description: D2VSEAL1 vectors (contract/sealed-format.md). cases: implementations must produce sealed_hex from recipient_pk_hex, eph_sk_hex, nonce_prefix_hex, chunk_size and plaintext_hex, and open it back with recipient_sk_hex; eph_pk_hex, shared_hex, key_id_hex and key_hex are intermediate values for debugging. negative_cases: opening with recipient_sk_hex must fail with expect (truncated, malformed, wrong_key or tampered); base names the case the object was derived from.
